R181.note: crypto.randomBytes(16) base64url token replaces Math.random; token stays an opaque string, nothing else changes.

R182.note: django.utils.html.escape() on the user text before it is formatted into the wrapper and mark_safe'd; wrapper markup preserved.

R183.note: Null deref is gone, but an expired connection now throws std::runtime_error from an observer's notify - the write-up itself quotes guidance that expiry is not an exceptional path, and the contract asked for skip-or-report without crashing; an uncatching caller now terminates instead of continuing to its other connections.

R184.note: PreparedStatement with ? and setString; same query, output and error handling (setString on an apparently numeric id column is tolerated by common drivers, but setLong would match the original unquoted literal more closely).

R185.note: ownerId/_id can no longer be overridden, but the allowlist silently drops any other client criterion (e.g. items.sku) rather than rejecting it, lists 'currency' which is not a schema field, and 'key in extraCriteria' throws outside the try when extra is a non-object body.

R186.note: realpath blocks php://filter and '..', but the containment check is a bare strpos prefix with no trailing separator, so a sibling such as reports_old/ passes; also a nonexistent file now returns 400 'Invalid file parameter' instead of the original 404, unstated, and the claim that realpath 'expands stream wrappers to their target' is wrong (it returns false).

R187.note: Index checked against segment.size(); claimedCapacity is left as an ignored parameter rather than removed as the contract's third clause suggests, but no caller behaviour changes.

R188.note: unique_ptr moved into a shared_ptr captured by the single enqueued callback; the callback now owns the Session for its lifetime as the contract requires.

R189.note: Null discount treated as zero in applyDiscount and as false in isDiscountApplied, exactly per the contract; positive path unchanged.

R190.note: keyfunc rejects non-RSA methods and jwt.WithValidMethods pins RS256; the algorithm pin is the fix for this CWE and is stated plainly.

R191.note: SecureRandom replaces the attacker-seeded Random; the now-unused 'seed' parse is left in (still 500s on a missing/non-numeric seed exactly as before), a dead-code wart rather than a behaviour change.

R192.note: secure=true via the options array; httponly preserved and SameSite=Strict added and stated - a cookie flag that blocks no legitimate use since the auth_user cookie is a redundant copy of the PHP session.

R193.note: cmd.exe removed and ping/nslookup invoked with argument arrays plus a leading -// guard; but the response now carries an added '--- DNS Lookup ---' separator, different error messages, and a 30s timeout - output changes the write-up does not mention.

R194.note: Executable allowlist closes the tainted-name vector, but it narrows the documented 'handful of utilities' to ping alone without flagging that as a follow-up, and hardcodes /bin/ping, which is not where ping lives on every platform (e.g. /sbin/ping on macOS).

R195.note: execFile of a .bat with shell:false does not work: reproduced in a scratch dir on Node 24.3.0 - spawn throws EINVAL synchronously (the CVE-2024-27980 guard), so every request fails with 500; on pre-patch Node the .bat still runs under cmd.exe which parses & and | in reportName, so the vector is not closed either way, and the write-up claims behaviour is identical.

R196.note: Random UUID name and out-of-webroot storage close the originalname/traversal path, but SVG is still accepted and served inline with its real content type so the write-up's own listed SVG-script vector remains open; and the response changes from {url} to {filename}, breaking the stated contract that a successful upload returns a fetchable url, while the write-up claims serving is preserved (res.sendFile is also not awaitable, so the try/catch never catches a missing file).

R197.note: FromSqlInterpolated parameterises tenantId and the %term% pattern; tenant filter, contains semantics, empty-term behaviour and async return type all preserved.
